```{r generador, include=FALSE}

options(knitr.duplicate.label = "allow")

library(googlesheets4)
library(rmarkdown)
library(pdftools)
library(fs)
library(glue)
library(dplyr)

if(params$participante == "Nombre del participante") {
  
  sheet_url <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1wruOysAqRKvsWfm0AI0NINHRfSaNwC_ZDoEhJT_2jBo/edit#gid=1482348962"
  
  data <- read_sheet(sheet_url, sheet = "training")
  
  data_filtrada <- data %>%
    filter(nc == 1) %>%
    mutate(Instructor = toupper(Instructor))
  
  nombres <- data_filtrada$Instructor
  
  output_dir <- "IT N° 04-2026"
  dir_create(output_dir)
  
  for(nombre in nombres){
    
    output_file <- path(
      output_dir,
      glue("Certificado{gsub('[^A-Za-z0-9]', '_', nombre)}.pdf")
    )
    
    render(
      input = "template_02.qmd",
      output_file = output_file,
      params = list(participante = nombre),
      envir = new.env()
    )
    
    cat(glue("Generado: {output_file}\n"))
  }
  
  knitr::knit_exit()
}
```
